valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.peEpsSource: net profit for FY2026 divided by the shares on file
valuation.pbFormula: current price / book value per share, where book value per share = total equity / shares outstanding
valuation.pbEquityRow: total_equity on the balance sheet for FY2026
valuation.pbSharesSource: the same 2.98098e+08 shares behind the market capitalisation (static_data\market_JSE.json)
valuation.psFormula: current price / revenue per share, where revenue per share = revenue / shares outstanding
valuation.psRevenueRow: the income statement's revenue line for FY2026, read from the row labelled 'Revenue'
valuation.psSharesSource: the same 2.98098e+08 shares behind the market capitalisation (static_data\market_JSE.json)
valuation.peRouteNote: the two P/E routes differ (market cap over net profit 22.71, price over EPS 25.15); the net-profit row reconciles with the filing's own profit before tax less tax, so the EPS row is the one filed in a different unit
valuation.peg_withheld_reason: Withheld: the same company (textonpropertyfundlimited) is served under two keys, TEX.JO and TEX, that stand on DIFFERENT filings: TEX.JO is the fresher period on file, so TEX is superseded and withheld while TEX.JO publishes the current year. Every market-based multiple of this security is built on that market cap, so none of them is a valuation. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.

derived.enterpriseValueBasis: market cap + borrowings - cash, both from the balance sheet for FY2026
